title: Sensei Governed Synthesis Session V1
description: The O1 canonical session document: a bounded, deterministic orchestration record binding a provider-independent session to exact repository, workspace-identity, graph-authority, task-session, and architectural-closure identity, plus a precommitted retry/replan budget. It coordinates work; it does not replace closure, admission, verification, completion, or promotion, and it carries no admission or verification identity of its own (that is recorded on the terminal Receipt, once produced).
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/synthesis. schema_version is a const, not a range: any field addition, removal, rename, or semantic change requires a new schema identifier. Every identity binding below is a reference (a plain value or an exact digest) to an existing typed owner elsewhere in Sensei — workspace_identity_digest_sha256 to workspacecontract.Identity, graph_authority_digest_sha256 to workspace/graph authority, task_session_digest_sha256 to tasksession.Session.SessionDigestSHA256, closure_digest_sha256 to the architectural closure/briefing artifact, proof_obligation_digests to closureprotocol.ProofDischarge records. This package never recreates or re-derives those owners' facts; it only composes their exact digests.

retry_budget.$comment: Precommitted at session creation. Immutable for the life of the session; the (Step 2) transition engine enforces monotonic non-increase, never enlargement.

created_at.$comment: RFC 3339 timestamp. An observation field: included here for bookkeeping, but session identity/equality for resumption purposes is carried by the digest fields above, not by this timestamp.

session_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing (closureprotocol.SemanticDigest convention).
